color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modification. Warm cream page background (#f0ece0, luminance 235.8) qualifies for light register. Added pageBackground, navBackground, navText fields to elements for downstream compatibility.

type-system.twistDescription: Font replacement: Helvetica Neue (proprietary) replaced with DM Sans via Google Fonts CDN. Twist B: Letter spacing injection (0.06em) added as --font-letter-spacing-heading, applied to heading scaleToken and h1/h2/h3 CSS rules.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Duration scaling ×1.5. All durations scaled: fast 0.127s→0.191s, base 0.254s→0.381s, slow 0.338s→0.507s, video 0.845s→1.267s. Creates deliberate, measured cadence.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Container padding change +12px (intensity 3). paddingLeft 15px→27px, paddingRight 15px→27px. More generous gutter breathing room at container edges.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Hero padding emphasis ×1.5 (intensity 3). Hero paddingTop 54px→81px, paddingRight 48px→72px, paddingBottom 54px→81px, paddingLeft 48px→72px. All other spacing unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist A: Hover transition speed — languid (intensity 3, +0.15s). Buttons: 0.45s→0.60s. Links: 0.25s→0.40s. Navigation links: 0.35s→0.50s. Unhurried hover character matching motion system cadence.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Letter spacing on nav links — intensity 3 (0.08em). Split-wing centered logo layout retained. Colors updated to match assembled palette (cream scrolled background, dark brown text). Transition duration updated to 381ms to match motion system.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Tone twist C (Material shift): Added specific tactile language about cream surface as working surface material (#f0ece0 as uncoated paper stock), amber as material signal rather than brand color, dark brown text as printed-text density. concept_by_video.md generated fresh for gilded-tempo's tidal motion philosophy.

productConcept.name: Amber Gate Lab
productConcept.description: Precision analog film processing laboratory in Rotterdam, handling 16mm, 35mm, and large-format film since 1994.
productConcept.rationale: The warm cream palette (#f0ece0) maps to uncoated photographic paper and fixer-bath amber; the measured motion system (0.381s base, languid hover 0.60s) echoes the chemical patience required for correct development; the generous hero padding (81px) mirrors the quiet required by the darkroom.
